# MADAR TECH website rules

- Keep the MADAR TECH identity consistent across every page: primary navy `#03213D`, lime accent `#D5E159`, and white `#FFFFFF` for contrast.
- Use a clear, calm, people-first visual style with generous spacing, readable typography, and restrained use of the accent color.
- Support English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) for all user-facing website text. Keep translations in sync and set the document language and direction when the language changes.
- Preserve both light and dark themes. Use the existing theme tokens and keep text, controls, focus indicators, and decorative elements legible in either mode.
- Make language and theme controls accessible by keyboard and screen readers, and persist the user's selections.
- Prefer the provided MADAR TECH wordmark and visual identity; do not introduce unrelated brand colors or substitute branding.
